brief: Prioritise Ashford Bluff 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-696) for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition because it is an ageing unit with a history of high loading that has a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Where this unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]).
